notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market analytics SaaS, B2B product teams. Currently running a small set of experiments on hosted APIs; interested in Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (Jordan) — high level product fit, cost/latency priorities. Customer: "we need <150ms p95 for chat flows".
- 2026-02-25: Demo of Hosted API (Priya) — showed streaming, function calling, embedding pipeline. Customer testing with sample docs.
- 2026-03-02: Deep technical call (Priya, infra lead Mateo) — discussed throughput patterns, token volumes (~600M tokens/mo projected), KV-cache behavior, and model variants. Fireflies ID FF-2026-03-02-8472.
- 2026-03-05: Security questionnaire submitted (drive link). Legal asked about DPA, data residency and KMS integration.
- 2026-03-09: Pricing check-in (Jordan) — confirmed interest in Dedicated reserved capacity, asked for a POC path and rollback guarantees.

POC scope (agreed tentatively):
- Goal: Validate Dedicated capacity for product assist chat + reranking pipeline at target p95 latency <=120ms and 75 req/s sustained.
- Duration: 4 weeks canary then evaluate metrics, then scale to pilot.
- Topology: 2x model variants in the canary — full-precision base model (higher quality) + 8-bit quantized variant (lower cost, slightly lower quality).
- Routing plan: Canary targets 5% of live traffic from staging -> routed to Dedicated cluster in us-east-1. Fallback rules: auto-failover to hosted API model variant in another region (us-west-2) if Dedicated CPU/GPU saturates or p95 breach >200ms for 3 consecutive mins.
- Rollback: automated circuit-breaker if error rate >2% or p95 >300ms for 2 minutes; immediate rollback to hosted API, notify AE/SE.
- Observability: need token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboards, and tracing hooks for request lineage.

Requirements & concerns (customer stated):
- SSO via SAML is required for team access to console.
- Keys must be under their KMS with ability to rotate; audit logs retention > 12 months.
- Prefer model pinning and immutable variants during POC to reproduce regressions.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to a 12-month Dedicated contract if POC shows >25% cost-per-inference improvement vs current hosted spend.
- Network: they will only allow outbound/inbound connections from whitelisted CIDR ranges; need detailed egress IP list for Dedicated.

Decisions to make / open items:
- Finalize Dedicated sizing (GPU type + instance count) based on POC load generator results. SE (Priya) to provide sizing calculator template.
- Legal: DPA + SOC2 addendum requested; legal cycle estimated 3 weeks.
- Pricing: need to send pricing addendum for 12-month reserved capacity and burst terms for canary.

Direct quote / paraphrase: "If we can get a canary with deterministic rollback and clear cost math, we'll greenlight a pilot and start procurement."

Suggested next actions (internal):
- Send Dedicated POC plan + runbook (Jordan/Priya) by 2026-03-12.
- Coordinate with infra ops to produce whitelist IPs and region failover playbook.
- Schedule kickoff call w/ engineering + security (target 2026-03-17).
